name: Accordion · tech specs
description: Dark technical specification list with divided rows.

items.question: Sensor
items.answer: 1-inch stacked CMOS, 48 megapixels, native ISO 100 to 12800.

items.question: Battery
items.answer: 4,800 mAh, up to 11 hours of continuous 4K recording. USB-C fast charging.

items.question: Storage
items.answer: Dual card slots, supports CFexpress Type B and UHS-II SD.

items.question: Build
items.answer: Magnesium alloy body, weather sealed to IP54.

items.question: Connectivity
items.answer: Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3 and tethered streaming over USB.
